brief:
Trump's "Board of Peace" said Monday that Israel needed to act immediately to help war-battered Gaza cope with impending winter, Al-Monitor reported. The board said measures ahead of deadly floods had been insufficient.

The statement comes as Gaza faces compounding humanitarian crises from ongoing conflict and seasonal weather threats. The board did not specify what additional steps Israel should take or provide a timeline for implementation.
dek: President Donald Trump's "Board of Peace" said Monday that Israel needed to act immediately to help war-battered Gaza cope with impending winter, saying measures ahead of deadly floods had been insufficient.
title: Trump's peace board urges Israel to accelerate Gaza aid before winter
